hooks.text: 选择英雄并以12种战斗流派构筑，在十余张地图上调整自动战斗策略。
hooks.excerpt: You will choose your favorite hero, build your heroes with 12 different combat genres, and adjust your strategy corresponding to 10+ different maps.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每局与另外七名机器人或真人玩家竞争，目标成为最终胜者。
hooks.excerpt: battle the other 7 Bots or Players to be the winner.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 对局还加入选秀与神器系统，为英雄构筑提供额外争夺和强化来源。
hooks.excerpt: There is also drafting and artifacts involved.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: requiring as many resources as Cyberpunk 2077 sometimes
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 更新后的等级系统破坏了原有体验。

opinions.text: 适合放空思考并获得笑点

excerpts.excerpt: when you need something you can stop thinking about and start laughing at.
